 Jennifer Aniston reveals which fellow A-lister gives her ‘hair envy’ 
 By 
 Avery Matera 
 Published 
 Nov. 10, 2026, 2:27 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source

 From “The Rachel” to her current soft, sun-kissed layers, Jennifer Aniston’s been serving up serious hair inspiration for decades — but even she gets “hair envy” from time to time.
 In a new Elle interview , the “Friends” star confessed she can’t get enough of pal Sandra Bullock’s luscious locks.
 “Sandy has the thickest head of hair on a woman over 40 that I’ve ever seen in my entire life!” Aniston said, adding that the “Practical Magic” actress is also among the “biggest supporters” of her hair care brand, LolaVie .
 “She’s ordered every product available from day one and continues to do so. I know she loves me, but God knows she doesn’t have to do that,” she shared.

 “Sandy has the thickest head of hair on a woman over 40 that I’ve ever seen in my entire life!” Aniston said. WireImage 
 Aniston previously waxed poetic about Bullock’s hair while chatting with her for Interview’s September cover story .
 “You’re one of the only women in my life with a head of hair that makes no sense. How you still have this mane is beyond me,” she told her friend.
 “Well, the only reason I don’t look like a Chia Pet is because of your stuff,” Bullock responded, referencing LolaVie.
 “I’ve had two bouts of stress-induced hair loss, so I’m very lucky it came back. That’s also thanks to my German grandmother. Full head of thick, crazy hair. I got those genes.”
 5 
 “She is also one of my biggest LolaVie supporters,” Aniston added of Bullock. “She’s ordered every product available from day one and continues to do so. I know she loves me, but God knows she doesn’t have to do that.” Getty Images for Netflix 
 5 
 The actress launched her hair care line in 2021. GC Images 
 Judging by a joint Instagram Reel the pair shared in August, Bullock’s particularly partial to LolaVie’s Lightweight Hair Oil .
 “This oil has tamed my hair. It’s fabulous. Everyone should swear by this,” she said in the clip.
 Aniston launched LolaVie in 2021 , and her brand recently released its Weightless Medium Hold Hairspray .
 “We wanted to create a product that gives you hold without sacrificing the feel of your hair,” she told Elle. “I don’t love anything that makes your hair stiff or crunchy.”
 We’re guessing Bullock’s already got her hands on a bottle of the stuff.
